longTitle.officialTitle: Making certain provisions with respect to internationally recognized human rights, refugees, and foreign relations.

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Human Rights, Refugee, and Other Foreign Relations Provisions Act of 1996”.

title.heading: CLAIBORNE PELL INSTITUTE FOR INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS AND PUBLIC POLICY

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This title may be cited as the “Claiborne Pell Institute for International Relations and Public Policy Act”.

section.heading: GRANT AUTHORIZED.
section.content: In recognition of the public service of Senator Claiborne Pell, the Secretary of Education is authorized to award a grant, in accordance with the provisions of this title, to assist in the establishment and operation of the Claiborne Pell Institute for International Relations and Public Policy, located at Salve Regina University, Newport, Rhode Island, including the purchase and renovation of facilities to house the Institute.

section.heading: AUTHORIZATION OF APPROPRIATIONS.
section.content: There are authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 1997 such sums, not to exceed $3,000,000, as may be necessary to carry out this title.

section.heading: EFFECTIVE DATE.
section.content: This title shall take effect on the date of enactment of this Act.

title.heading: GEORGE BUSH SCHOOL OF GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC SERVICE

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This title may be cited as the “George Bush School of Government and Public Service Act”.

section.heading: GRANT AUTHORIZED.
section.content: In recognition of the public service of President George Bush, the Secretary of Education is authorized to make a grant in accordance with the provisions of this Act to assist in the establishment of the George Bush Fellowship Program, located at the George Bush School of Government and Public Service of the Texas A & M University.

section.heading: GRANT CONDITIONS.
section.content: No payment may be made under this title except upon an application at such time, in such manner, and containing or accompanied by such information as the Secretary of Education may require.

section.heading: APPROPRIATIONS AUTHORIZED.
section.content: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums, not to exceed $3,000,000, as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this title.

section.heading: EFFECTIVE DATE.
section.content: This title shall take effect on October 1, 1996.

section.heading: EDMUND S. MUSKIE FOUNDATION.
section.content: In recognition of the public service of Senator and Secretary of State Edmund S. Muskie, the Secretary of Education is authorized to award a grant in accordance with the provisions of this Act to assist in the establishment of the Edmund S. Muskie Foundation, located in Washington, D.C., by providing assistance to support the Foundation, including assistance to be used for awarding stewardships, supporting the Muskie archives, and supporting the Edmund S. Muskie Institute of Public Affairs.

paragraph.heading: Foundation.—
paragraph.content: The term “Foundation” means the Calvin Coolidge Memorial Foundation.

paragraph.heading: Secretary.—
paragraph.content: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Education.

subsection.heading: Grant Authorized.—
subsection.content: The Secretary is authorized to make a grant in the amount of $1,000,000 in accordance with the provisions of this section to the Foundation.

paragraph.heading: Application.—
paragraph.content:
No payment may be made under this section except upon an application at such time, in such
manner, and containing or accompanied by such information as the Secretary may require.

paragraph.heading: Use of grant funds.—
paragraph.chapeau:
Funds received under this
section may be used for any of the following purposes:

subparagraph.content: To increase the endowment of the Foundation.
To conduct educational, archival, or preservation activities of the Foundation.

subsection.heading: Authorization of Appropriations.—
subsection.content: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary $1,000,000, without fiscal year limitation, to carry out the provisions of this section.

subsection.heading: Effective Date.—
subsection.content: This section shall take effect on October 1, 1996.
